Herlev is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, utilizing national registry data to benchmark healthcare performance [^src1]. 

In this report, Herlev is specifically noted for its data concerning stroke (apoplexy) events among patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. This information is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for "Indicator 5," which measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. Herlev's inclusion, alongside data from all 98 Danish municipalities, highlights the report's role as a comprehensive tool for local quality development and regional benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
